d: Amid the ongoing debate over the use of E20 fuel, the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) Monday notified a key change in the Central Motor Vehicle Rules, allowing the flex-fuel vehicles to run on up to E100 or nearly pure ethanol. This does not mean that every petrol car can use E100 now. The new regulation expands the range of fuels that can be used in vehicles and paves the way for the manufacturing and supply of more flex-fuel vehicle components, ethanol production infrastructure, and the deployment of such vehicles on the road.
